subject.title: fix(macos): refresh skills after local node reconnect

question: Which single reconnect-refresh PR should remain the landing candidate for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/107391 once comparable native macOS proof is available?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same reproduced behavior with materially similar notification-and-refresh designs, and neither has sufficient real-device proof to establish a safe canonical replacement.

options.title: Select one proven candidate
options.body: Require redacted native macOS reconnect proof, then retain one PR as the canonical fix and close or withdraw the other to avoid duplicated implementation.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer prefers a different event boundary or verifies the issue no longer reproduces on current main.
